description: This file contains platform-specific upgrade and image check logic for different hardware boards within a Linux-based embedded system. It defines functions for performing upgrade operations, checking images, and copying configuration based on board types.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process based on board type and magic values.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the image for the current hardware platform.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies the configuration to the device based on the board type.
